applicabilityBasis.summary: The tracked contract 0xBe1922750760C4CAE69edB6FE79a22ae9b62a23d is sUSD (SUDC), a transferable ERC-20 wrapper. The issuer's sUSD page lists this address as the sUSD token and markets it as transferable liquidity tradable against USDC at an indicative 1:1 rate on PancakeSwap, and the official contract repository implements SUDC as a tradeable wrapper minted one-way from hedge-locked hUSDC, the transfer-restricted staking position. Unwrapping is disabled with no holder redemption function, the wrapper operator can burn balances and sweep the wrapped hUSDC, and yield comes from Venus lending distributed by operator-triggered reward mints. The token is a yield wrapper with no fixed fiat monetary-value redemption undertaking, not an offered payment instrument.

genius.notes: The tracked contract is the transferable sUSD (SUDC) wrapper minted one-way from hedge-locked hUSDC staking receipts, not the transfer-restricted staking token itself and not a Circle-issued token. Issuer materials conflict on labels: the introductory documentation describes sUSD as soul-bound and hUSDC as tradeable, while the sUSD product page and official contract repository list the tracked address as the transferable token traded against USDC on PancakeSwap. Unwrapping is disabled by design; exit relies on PancakeSwap liquidity or operator-controlled burns, and the wrapper operator can sweep the wrapped hUSDC backing. Exact legal issuer entity and domicile were not established from the protocol disclosures, so neither is invented. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
